triggers.source_anchor_quote_en: the after one was placed over the turbine hatch and was used as a ventilator
triggers.unexplained_relation_zh: 第四个 funnel 不是排烟却仍被做成 funnel 形态；文段没解释它如何同时服务通风、厨房排气与上层建筑外观。
triggers.possible_missing_variable_zh: 机舱通风与外观整合的设计机制

triggers.source_anchor_quote_en: The uptakes by which the waste gases were conveyed to the funnels were united immediately above the water-tight bulkhead
triggers.unexplained_relation_zh: 相邻锅炉房的 uptakes 为何偏偏在水密舱壁上方合并；文段只给了布置事实，没解释这与水密完整性和结构支撑的关系。
triggers.possible_missing_variable_zh: 穿越/贴邻水密边界的结构与风险约束

triggers.source_anchor_quote_en: All overhead discharge from the circulating pumps, ballast pumps, bilge pumps, etc., were below the deep load line, but above the light line.
triggers.unexplained_relation_zh: 排放口相对 deep/light load line 的位置显然重要，但文段没解释这对应的吃水变化、回灌风险与阀件要求。
triggers.possible_missing_variable_zh: 随载重变化的淹没状态与防虹吸/防倒灌机制

triggers.source_anchor_quote_en: The boilers were supported in built steel cradles, and were stayed to the ship's side and to each other athwart ships by strong steel stays.
triggers.unexplained_relation_zh: 锅炉为何既要 cradle 支承，又要横向 stays、纵向 chocks；文段没解释它们分别应对什么力学问题。
triggers.possible_missing_variable_zh: 船体运动/碰撞载荷与热膨胀的双重约束

triggers.source_anchor_quote_en: Silent blow-offs from the main steam pipes were connected direct to both condensers.
triggers.unexplained_relation_zh: “silent blow-off” 直接接入 condenser 说明它不只是放汽；文段没解释它怎样调压、降噪并避免破坏冷凝系统。
triggers.possible_missing_variable_zh: 闭式蒸汽循环中的 bleed-line 调压机制

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: the after one was placed over the turbine hatch and was used as a ventilator
seeds.external_lens_identity: dummy funnel as a ventilation enclosure in ocean-liner naval architecture
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这里的第四个 funnel 不是“假装排烟”这么简单，而是把 turbine room 的通风竖井和 galley 排气整合进一个高耸外壳里：它同时解决大机舱抽排气需求，并避免甲板上另起一排笨重 ventilators。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句不再只是说明“第四根不冒烟”，而是在说明一个把机舱通风、厨房排烟和船体外观绑定在一起的整合设计。
source_leads: The Shipbuilder / Encyclopedia Titanica, 'Olympic & Titanic : The Propelling Machinery' (fourth funnel used for ventilating purposes; galley chimney built into it): https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/the-propelling-machinery.html

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: The uptakes by which the waste gases were conveyed to the funnels were united immediately above the water-tight bulkhead
seeds.external_lens_identity: watertight-boundary penetration control in marine subdivision design
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 把相邻锅炉房的 uptakes 放到水密舱壁上方才合并，机制上是在保住下部舱室分隔的前提下，再利用舱壁作为上部 uptake/funnel 的支撑。也就是说，这不是随手合并管道，而是在“分舱完整性”和“上部大型烟道受力”之间取平衡。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，‘immediately above the water-tight bulkhead’ 变成关键条件：合并位置本身就在告诉你设计者在规避下部水密边界被削弱。
source_leads: The Shipbuilder / Encyclopedia Titanica, 'Olympic & Titanic : The Propelling Machinery' (bulkhead forms a valuable support to the uptakes and funnel above): https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/the-propelling-machinery.html

USCG circular 'Watertight Bulkheads in All Inspected Vessels Maintenance of Watertight Integrity' / damage-control guidance on penetrations through watertight bulkheads: https://rosap.ntl.bts.gov/view/dot/64069

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: All overhead discharge from the circulating pumps, ballast pumps, bilge pumps, etc., were below the deep load line, but above the light line.
seeds.external_lens_identity: load-line-dependent overboard discharge and anti-siphon/backflooding risk
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这个位置选择的关键不是几何描述，而是载重变化下的淹没状态切换：轻载时排口可能露出水面，深载时则会沉到水下。于是这些 discharge 需要靠近舷侧设置可靠阀件/止回安排，否则管路破损或停泵时就可能形成回灌或虹吸进水。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句从“安装位置说明”变成了“载重状态改变系统风险”的提示，light/deep load line 是功能边界，不是背景名词。
source_leads: NOAA, 'What is a Plimsoll line?' (explains load line meaning): https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/plimsoll-line.html
46 CFR 56.50-95 'Overboard discharges and shell connections' (valves/nonreturn protection for submerged discharges): https://ecfr.io/Title-46/Section-56.50-95

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: The boilers were supported in built steel cradles, and were stayed to the ship's side and to each other athwart ships by strong steel stays.
seeds.external_lens_identity: marine machinery chocking and bracing under dynamic loads with thermal-expansion allowance
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: cradles、athwartship stays 和 fore-and-aft chocks 不是重复加固，而是在分工处理不同载荷：cradle 承重与定位，横向 stays 抵抗横摇/侧向惯性，前后 chocks 防止纵向窜动，尤其在碰撞或急剧运动时限制锅炉位移；同时支承方案还必须预留受热膨胀。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这段不再只是‘锅炉固定得很牢’，而是在编码一套面向船体运动、碰撞和热膨胀的约束分解。
source_leads: 46 CFR 52.01-130 'Installation' (boiler foundations must allow expansion; boilers need chocks against collision movement): https://chanrobles.com/usa/uslaws/cfr/title46/46-2.0.1.2.10.1.1.17.php
Maritime.org, 'Shipyard Outside Machinist - Part 2' (fitted chocks keep machinery from shifting and losing alignment): https://www.maritime.org/doc/machinist/part2.php

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: Silent blow-offs from the main steam pipes were connected direct to both condensers.
seeds.external_lens_identity: silent blow-off as a condenser bleed-line in a closed-loop steam plant
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: silent blow-off 的作用不是普通泄放，而是把主蒸汽管里的多余蒸汽导回冷凝系统作为调压 bleed line，用来避免待机时锅炉安全阀频繁起跳，同时保住闭式循环里的给水；之所以能‘silent’，正因为蒸汽不是直接向大气尖叫排放。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句从一个配管细节变成整套蒸汽循环控制逻辑的入口：它说明这艘船在用 condenser 吸收部分调压任务，而不是只靠 safety valves。
source_leads: Samuel Halpern, 'Titanic's Prime Mover' (silent blow-off used as bleed line to prevent safety valves lifting; steam routed to condenser): https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/titanic-prime-mover.html
